caption: The drawing features three views of a round, ornamental metal object with intricate scrollwork patterns. At the top, there is a front view of the object drawn in fine lines, showing a symmetrical, circular design with swirling, vine-like elements radiating from the center, enclosed by a circular frame. The outer edge has four protruding details that resemble small decorative feet spaced at equal intervals. Below the front view, a side profile of the object is displayed, illustrating its flat surface and the distinct shape of the feet underneath, along with a small ruler for scale marked in inches. At the bottom, a more shaded and detailed perspective view is presented, displaying the object resting on its four feet, with the curved scrollwork and central swirling motif clearly visible. The entire composition is rendered in grayscale on a plain, light background, and a signature "H. Grüsetein" is visible in the lower left corner.
title: Trivet
